scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api --if-present && npm run lint -w apps/web --if-present
